3240-5231-6277-6462.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

792-3025-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-3025-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4823-4826-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4823-4826-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
4823-4826-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Timeless Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-5687--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-5687--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1870-4873-5087-7714.easyPrerequisites: The sum of the number of charge counters on Darksteel Reactor and your life total is at least 20.
1870-4873-5087-7714.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature or artifact to leave the battlefield.
1870-4873-5087-7714.description:
Cast Eternity Vessel by paying {6}.
When Eternity Vessel enters, Ultron triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to create an artifact creature token copy of it that enters with a number of charge counters on it equal to your life total.
Cause the Eternity Vessel creature token to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

4050-5220-7806.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
4050-5220-7806.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Naga Fleshcrafter and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1256-1270-5477-7730.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-5879-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Walking Archive.
When Walking Archive dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3617-4863-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4565-5189-7426.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
2034-4565-5189-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1308-1651-7318.description:
Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

4131-4893-7290.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
4131-4893-7290.description:
Cause Basalt Monolith to become a creature using Does Machines.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

304-539-3899-4365-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tough Cookie.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

7-2342-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-2342-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
The Shaman en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat.

1818-3490-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-3490-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2275-3532-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1632-1987-4311-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Stonespeaker Crystal by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Stonespeaker Crystal.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3817-4681-6797.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4871-5433-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.
4871-5433-6798.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Goblin token.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2275-3583-4067.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}.
2275-3583-4067.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Oloro's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Oloro's second ability triggers, holding priority, activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers. Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the Shabraz trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

with a brain counter on it

1247-5536-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 2 or greater.
1247-5536-6478.description:
Activate Rex using Arbor Adherent's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

662-1651-4321-5251.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Emmara to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-4444-5742-5743.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1429-2981-4452-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2981-4452-5402.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

1778-4875-5852.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
1778-4875-5852.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Memnite triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Memnite spells, causing the nontoken Memnite to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

578-2043-3472.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
578-2043-3472.description:
If needed, activate Ring of Valkas' equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Metalworker.
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least four artifact cards from your hand, adding at least eight {C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Metalworker that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Activate Ring of Valkas' equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Metalworker token.
Repeat from step 2 using the Metalworker token instead.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may target any artifact you control to get infinite copies of them.

uses.n: Plargg, Dean of Chaos // Augusta, Dean of Order

2751-4241-4784.notablePrerequisites:
Dean of Order.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
You control a creature that can attack this turn.
2751-4241-4784.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Strionic Resonator to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Move to your combat phase, and declare any creature you control as an attacker, triggering Augusta.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Augusta's ability.
Resolve the copy of Augusta's ability, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.
